name: Fluphenazine
summary: Fluphenazine, sold under the brand name Prolixin among others, is a high-potency typical antipsychotic medication of the phenothiazine class. It is used in the treatment of chronic psychoses such as schizophrenia, and is about equal in effectiveness to low-potency antipsychotics like chlorpromazine. It is also used to treat depression in combination with nortriptyline.
